{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern P-LIT-PRIORITIZE aims to provide earlier failure feedback by reordering tests. In this workflow, there is only one job. To implement the pattern's intent of 'ranking' or 'prioritizing' within the constraints of a single-step workflow, I will split the single 'codespell' job into two distinct jobs: one for a fast, narrow check (e.g., checking only specific high-risk directories or a subset of files) and one for the full check. This allows the 'fast' job to fail early. Since the exact file list is internal to the action, I will simulate prioritization by splitting the execution into a 'fast' check and a 'full' check using the action's capability to target paths, thereby providing a structural implementation of the prioritization mechanism.",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Codespell configuration is within pyproject.toml
---
name: Codespell

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  codespell-fast:
    name: Check for spelling errors (Fast)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Annotate locations with typos
        uses: codespell-project/codespell-problem-matcher@9ba2c57125d4908eade4308f32c4ff814c184633
      - name: Codespell Fast
        uses: codespell-project/actions-codespell@8f01853be192eb0f849a5c7d721450e7a467c579
        with:
          # Prioritize checking core source files for early feedback
          path: "src"

  codespell-full:
    name: Check for spelling errors (Full)
    needs: codespell-fast
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Annotate locations with typos
        uses: codespell-project/codespell-problem-matcher@9ba2c57125d4908eade4308f32c4ff814c184633
      - name: Codespell Full
        uses: codespell-project/actions-codespell@8f01853be192eb0f849a5c7d721450e7a467c579
"
}
